entries.ordinances: Ord. 37 (1924) and Ord. 47 (1924) creating segregated residential districts; Ord. 136 (1933) sundown law
entries.summary: City commission unanimously repealed three segregation-era ordinances, including a 1933 sundown law barring people of another race from segregated districts after dark.
